description: Land Title Settlement Department - Galthotamulla, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511826 (22/55061)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) and the potential registration of land titles under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The notice is issued by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement, further confirming its land-related nature. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
